headline: Triumvir Law advises WLDD on securing strategic investments; Trilegal, Badaya, Argus, Khimani advise investors
sum: WLDD Private Limited has secured strategic investments from Adfactors PR Private Limited and Vikas Khemani Group, through a combination of primary subscription of compulsorily convertible preference shares and secondary sale of equity…
detail: WLDD Private Limited has secured strategic investments from Adfactors PR Private Limited and Vikas Khemani Group, through a combination of primary subscription of compulsorily convertible preference shares and secondary sale of equity shares. Triumvir Law advised WLDD on this transaction. The firm advised the Company on the review of the term sheet, the drafting and negotiation of the transaction documents, through to closing. The transaction team consisted of Anubhab Sarkar (Managing Partner), Ajay Kumar (Partner), Ragini Chakraborty (Senior Associate), Associates Arjun Krishnan and Sakshi Singhania.
